history.text: Portuguese navigators reached Bioko, then called Formosa.
Spain acquired the islands and mainland rights by treaty.
Francisco Macias Nguema's rule caused mass flight and killings.
Offshore oil discoveries transformed state revenues.

worthSeeing.title: Pico Basile:
worthSeeing.text: The volcanic summit of Bioko island, overlooking Malabo.

worthSeeing.title: Malabo old quarter:
worthSeeing.text: Spanish colonial architecture and the cathedral above the harbour.

worthSeeing.title: Monte Alen:
worthSeeing.text: Mainland rainforest park with forest elephants and primates.
